_comment: v0.4.0 視覺探針（甲：紅暈／乙：低錢發光＋帳單 toast）。防禦式：功能未落地時檢查回 SKIP，寫手 push 後 checkout 新 main 直接跑。零截圖優先。

checks.name: heat_vignette_element
checks.expr: (function(){var cands=['#heatFx','.heat-vignette','#vignette','.heat-glow','#fx-heat','.mk-heatfx']; var found=cands.filter(function(s){return document.querySelector(s);}); var styleHasHeat=false; try{var css=Array.from(document.styleSheets).flatMap(function(ss){try{return Array.from(ss.cssRules);}catch(e){return [];}}); styleHasHeat=css.some(function(r){return r.cssText&&/heat/i.test(r.cssText)&&(/vignette|glow|box-shadow|radial/i.test(r.cssText));});}catch(e){} return JSON.stringify({featurePresent: found.length>0||styleHasHeat, foundSelectors: found, styleHasHeatRule: styleHasHeat});})()

checks.name: heat_vignette_intensity
checks.expr: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('#heatFx,.heat-vignette,#vignette,.heat-glow,#fx-heat,.mk-heatfx'); if(!el) return 'SKIP: no element'; var s=Sim.state(); var out=[]; [0,50,95].forEach(function(h){ if(typeof s.heat!=='undefined') s.heat=h; GameMap.refreshHeatFX && GameMap.refreshHeatFX(); var cs=getComputedStyle(el); out.push({heat: h, opacity: cs.opacity, boxShadow: cs.boxShadow.slice(0,120), background: cs.backgroundImage.slice(0,120)});}); return JSON.stringify(out);})()

checks.name: low_money_pulse_class
checks.expr: (function(){var btn=document.querySelector('#misPanel button'); if(!btn) return 'SKIP: no mission panel button'; var s=Sim.state(); var saved=s.kkcoin; s.kkcoin=50; try{ if(typeof renderMissionDetail==='function'){renderMissionDetail();} }catch(e){} var after=document.querySelector('#misPanel .lowMoneyPulse, #misPanel button.lowMoneyPulse'); var anim=after?getComputedStyle(after).animationName:'n/a'; s.kkcoin=saved; return JSON.stringify({found:!!after, className:after?after.className:null, animationName:anim});})()

checks.name: toast_structure
checks.expr: (function(){var holder=document.getElementById('toasts'); if(!holder) return 'SKIP: no #toasts'; var before=holder.children.length; holder.innerHTML=''; var test=document.createElement('div'); test.className='toast'; test.textContent='🧾 TEST 123'; holder.appendChild(test); var cs=getComputedStyle(test); var hasSheetRule=Array.from(document.styleSheets).some(function(ss){try{return Array.from(ss.cssRules).some(function(r){return r.selectorText&&/\.toast/.test(r.selectorText);});}catch(e){return false;}}); test.remove(); return JSON.stringify({holderExists:true, toastClass:cs?cs.display:'n/a', sheetRule:hasSheetRule});})()

checks.name: toast_auto_dismiss
checks.expr: (function(){var holder=document.getElementById('toasts'); if(!holder) return 'SKIP'; holder.innerHTML=''; var t=document.createElement('div'); t.className='toast'; t.textContent='🧾 AUTO?'; holder.appendChild(t); var keep=t; return 'planted:'+(holder.children.length);})()
checks._note: showToast 的 setTimeout 4.2s 會移除；此檢查後另以 JS 讀 #toasts 子數驗證自動清空。實際帳單 toast 由 sim 21:00 觸發，等寫手接線後再驗內容（收支明細）。
